meta.name: add-dashboard
meta.description: Add a monitoring dashboard to NanoClaw. Installs @nanoco/nanoclaw-dashboard and a pusher that sends periodic JSON snapshots.

copy.tagline: 为 NanoClaw 添加监控仪表盘并推送数据快照
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在使用 NanoClaw 并需要可视化运行状态
copy.tagline_en: Add a monitoring dashboard and push data snapshots to NanoClaw
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use NanoClaw and need to visualize its runtime status

howto.what: 这个技能让 Claude 给 NanoClaw 项目加本地监控仪表盘:安装 npm 包、复制推送模块与测试、改 index.ts、设置环境变量,构建测试后重启。网页显示代理组、会话、消息、令牌用量和实时日志。
howto.when: 当你要求给 NanoClaw 添加监控仪表盘,或明确提到“dashboard”“实时日志”时触发。

say.text: 给 NanoClaw 加一个监控仪表盘
say.note: Claude 会运行此技能完成安装配置

say.text: 帮我装上 NanoClaw 的 dashboard
say.note: 会复制推送模块并在本地启动面板

say.text: 为 NanoClaw 配置仪表盘端口和密钥

howto.what_en: Claude installs a NanoClaw dashboard npm package, copies a pusher and tests, edits index.ts, sets env vars, builds and restarts. A web UI then shows agent groups, sessions, messages, token usage, and live logs.
howto.when_en: When you ask to add a monitoring dashboard to NanoClaw, or mention 'dashboard' or 'realtime logs'.

say_en.text: Add a monitoring dashboard to NanoClaw.
say_en.note: Claude will run the skill and set it up.

say_en.text: Set up NanoClaw's dashboard for me.
say_en.note: It copies the pusher and starts the panel locally.

say_en.text: Configure DASHBOARD_SECRET and port for NanoClaw.
say_en.note: Generates the secret, writes .env, and restarts.
